subject: Follow-up: decision gates, hosting preference, latency/cost targets

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@healthedge.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: decision gates, hosting preference, latency/cost targets

Alex — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap while the items are fresh and a couple of clarifying asks so we can scope an accurate proposal:

1) Decision criteria (what you called out):
   - Primary: predictable p95 latency and SLA (uptime + recovery) for the customer-facing assistant.
   - Secondary: unit cost per active user / per-month cost envelope (upper-bound for long-term run rate).
   - Non-functional: VPC / data residency for PHI adjacency, and SOC2 evidence for procurement.

2) Hosting preference you flagged: Private deployment (VPC) preferred for production pilot, with a hosted option for a short-term POC.

3) Latency & cost targets (we discussed rough bands on the call). Please confirm these two so we can recommend configurations:
   - Target p95 generation latency for typical prompts: ? ms (you mentioned sub-300ms as ideal; please confirm if 200ms is required or 300ms acceptable)
   - Monthly unit-cost target: ? (you mentioned this should fit within an internal budget band; any $/month or $/1M token guidance helps)

4) Economic buyer / procurement path: can you confirm the primary economics owner (CFO/VP of Product) and who will lead the procurement engagement?

Attached: hosting_options_summary.xlsx — quick matrix comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs VPC (high level).

Next steps from our side: once you confirm the latency target and the primary procurement owner, I’ll loop in Neha (security) and Lauren (solutions/pricing) with a tailored proposal and an SLA sketch.

Thanks — Rishi

--

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Economic buyer: Lydia Cho (CFO) will own commercial approvals. I’ve looped her on this thread.
- Procurement: procurement@healthedge.com is the staging inbox — they’ll push their formal security questionnaire if we move past technical review.
- Latency targets: for customer-facing chat (multi-turn), our internal bar is p95 <= 250ms for short prompts (~40-80 tokens). For more complex generation (>200 tokens) p95 <= 500ms is acceptable. The 250ms is the hard constraint for our UX team.
- Cost guidance: we’re looking for a run-rate that keeps incremental inference costs under $15k/month for the pilot (approximate). If your hosted pilot hits that envelope we can consider moving to private for production.
- Hosting preference: strong preference for VPC/private for production pilot. Hosted POC is acceptable for the first 2–4 week evaluation to validate UX, but production must be private.

We’ll get procurement to send over the security questionnaire. In the meantime, could you share an SLA sketch and a short note on how you meet p95 latency (resource sizing / batching approach)?

Attachment: security_questionnaire_Healthedge.pdf (procurement said they’ll send a more complete pack later).

—Alex
